verdict.rationale: First-party docs say LlamaCloud, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, can be deployed entirely in your own infrastructure. It ships as self-hosted/BYOC with Helm charts on Kubernetes across AWS, Azure or GCP, with the platform's full capabilities and data, models and infrastructure under your control. The enterprise-readiness page also lists self-hosting alongside SaaS, single-tenant and regional options. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of a working self-hosted deployment, and clarity on availability or licensing terms (e.g. whether it is enterprise-gated, or whether the code is open source).
